dedupe_keys.name: eu energy atlas gridded energy supply and demand for 2024 2030 2040 and 2050

description: The EU Energy Atlas gives gridded maps of where energy is supplied and consumed across all EU member states, at 1 km resolution on the Eurostat reference grid, for 2024, 2030, 2040 and 2050. It was issued in September 2026 by the European Commission's Joint Research Centre with Julien Collaer as creator, and is referenced by two JRC reports. Supply and demand are given by energy product (solid fossil fuels, crude oil, petroleum products, natural gas, other fuels, renewable electricity, non-electric renewables, nuclear heat, heat, electricity, hydrogen and synthetic fuels) and by activity: transformation, including power and heat plants, coke ovens, blast furnaces and refineries; industry by branch; transport by mode, including pipelines; and other sectors such as households, services and agriculture. Values are in kilotonnes of oil equivalent, consistent with the 2024 energy balance and the CETO 2025 scenario for later years, with folders for supply, demand and their balance. Coverage is the EU. Maps are GeoTIFF files downloadable from the JRC Data Catalogue at no cost under CC BY-NC-SA 4.0. Caveats: the spatial distribution is estimated, not metered, and the licence restricts commercial use. Simulation uses are mapping exposure of energy supply and demand to hazards and planning future networks. Related records: none linked on the provider's pages read on the day.
